news.title: SS Rajamouli Reflects on Filming His Most Violent Scene With Jr NTR Outside Kerala Assembly
news.summary: Filmmaker SS Rajamouli recently looked back at a remarkably intense action sequence featuring Jr NTR, noting it as the most violent piece of work in his career. He expressed doubt over whether shooting such a sequence outside the Kerala Assembly would even be possible under current circumstances.
body: Renowned filmmaker SS Rajamouli has opened up about a particularly intense sequence from his directorial career. Looking back at his past projects, the director recalled shooting what he considers the most violent scene he has ever brought to the screen.

The sequence notably featured actor Jr NTR and was filmed outside the Kerala Assembly. Reflecting on the logistical and creative realities of that production, Rajamouli shared his doubts about executing such a sequence today, admitting he is uncertain if it would be possible now.
Such reflections offer a fascinating look into the evolving nature of film production and the changing permissions and environments surrounding major cinematic shoots in real-world public locations.
